core_finding: Blast radius of a stolen issuer signing key = exactly the conforming subset (3/8): bounded by validity window, revocation list, delegation depth, and session-side authority/tenant context — NOT by scope or identity claims, which the stolen key mints freely. Authority that lives only in the token is unlimited authority; authority that lives in the session policy is bounded. Verifier compromise: with HMAC the learned secret forges 4/4; with ed25519 the verifier holds no secret and forgeries reject 4/4.

run1_disclosure: Run 1 failed F1/F3/F4 on instrument defects, preserved in n8587_evidence/runner_run1_defective.py + journal_run1.json. Defect 1: no wildcard-scope semantics (owner heal:* wrongly rejected). Defect 2 (the headline): the gate took session tenant and entitlement from the PRESENTED TOKEN — the exact tenantGuard anti-pattern — and stolen-key forgeries sailed through (5/8). With session-side injected context the same attacker gets 3/8: the delta is the doctrine, measured. Defect 3: HMAC control modeled the attacker with a wrong secret instead of the one learned from verifier memory.
